tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: List all available tools with schemas

tools.name: vice_memory_read
tools.description: Read memory range (with optional bank selection)

address.description: Address: number, hex string ($1000), or symbol name

bank.description: Optional: Memory bank name (e.g., 'ram' to read RAM under ROM). Use vice.memory.banks to list available banks.

encoding.description: Optional: 'array' for legacy per-byte hex strings, or 'hex' for one compact hex string.

address.description: Address: number, hex string ($1000), or symbol name

tools.name: vice_memory_search
tools.description: Search for byte patterns in memory with optional wildcards

start.description: Start address: number, hex string ($C000), or symbol name

end.description: End address: number, hex string ($FFFF), or symbol name

pattern.description: Byte pattern to find, e.g., [0x4C, 0x00, 0xA0] for JMP $A000

start.description: Start address: number, hex string ($1000), or symbol name

end.description: End address: number, hex, or symbol (optional, default=start)

sprite.description: Sprite number 0-7 (omit to get all sprites)

registers.description: Array of {offset, value} objects to set VIC-II registers (offset 0x00-0x2E)
Array of {offset, value} objects to set SID registers (offset 0x00-0x1C)

cia.description: CIA chip number: 1 or 2 (optional, default returns both)

cia1_registers.description: Array of {offset, value} objects to set CIA1 registers (offset 0x00-0x0F)

cia2_registers.description: Array of {offset, value} objects to set CIA2 registers (offset 0x00-0x0F)

tools.name: vice_autostart
tools.description: Autostart a PRG or disk image

path.description: Path to PRG file or disk image (.d64, .g64, .prg)

program.description: Program name to load from disk image (optional)

tools.name: vice_machine_reset
tools.description: Reset the machine (soft or hard reset)

mode.description: Reset mode: 'soft' (CPU reset, default) or 'hard' (power cycle)

path.description: File path to save screenshot (optional if return_base64=true)

format.description: Image format: PNG or BMP (default: PNG)

return_base64.description: Return screenshot as base64 data URI (default: false)

tools.name: vice_keyboard_type
tools.description: Type text (uppercase ASCII displays as uppercase on C64 by default)

text.description: Text to type (converts to PETSCII). Use \n for Return.

petscii_upper.description: Default true: uppercase ASCII displays as uppercase on C64. Set false for raw PETSCII (uppercase ASCII maps to graphics)

tools.name: vice_keyboard_petscii
tools.description: Feed exact PETSCII bytes into the KERNAL keyboard buffer

data.description: Exact PETSCII bytes to feed to the KERNAL keyboard buffer (1-255 each; 13 is Return)

key.description: Key name or VHK code. Names: Return, Space, BackSpace, Delete, Escape, Tab, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, F1-F8, or single char

modifiers.description: Optional modifiers: shift, control, ctrl, alt, meta, command, cmd

hold_frames.description: Hold duration in frames (1-300). Key auto-releases after this many frames (~16.7ms each at 60Hz)

hold_ms.description: Hold duration in milliseconds (1-5000). Key auto-releases after this time. Overrides hold_frames if both specified

key.description: Key name or VHK code. Names: Return, Space, BackSpace, Delete, Escape, Tab, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, F1-F8, or single char

modifiers.description: Optional modifiers: shift, control, ctrl, alt, meta, command, cmd

tools.name: vice_keyboard_restore
tools.description: Press/release RESTORE key (triggers NMI, not in matrix)

pressed.description: Key pressed state: true to press (triggers NMI), false to release (default: true)

direction.description: Direction: up, down, left, right, center, or array for diagonals

tools.name: vice_joystick_tap
tools.description: Tap joystick direction/fire for a fixed number of frames, then center

direction.description: Direction: up, down, left, right, center, or array for diagonals

duration_ms.description: Tap duration in milliseconds (1-5000). Overrides duration_frames if both specified

address.description: Start address: number, hex string ($1000), or symbol name

count.description: Number of instructions to disassemble (default: 10, max: 100)

show_symbols.description: Show symbol names in output (default: true)

tools.name: vice_symbols_load
tools.description: Load symbol/label file (VICE, KickAssembler, simple formats)

format.description: Format: 'auto' (default), 'kickasm', 'vice', or 'simple'. Auto-detects KickAssembler (.label/.namespace) vs VICE (al C:xxxx) format

tools.name: vice_symbols_lookup
tools.description: Lookup symbol by name or address

name.description: Symbol name to look up (returns address)

address.description: Address to look up (returns symbol name)

tools.name: vice_watch_add
tools.description: Add memory watchpoint with optional condition (shorthand for checkpoint with store/load)

address.description: Address: number, hex string ($1000), or symbol name

condition.description: Condition expression for conditional watchpoint. Supported: 'A == $xx', 'X == $xx', 'Y == $xx', 'PC == $xxxx', 'SP == $xx'. For store watches, condition is evaluated after the store completes.

depth.description: Max stack frames to show (default: 16, max: 64)

tools.name: vice_run_until
tools.description: Run until address or for N cycles (with timeout)

address.description: Target address: number, hex, or symbol (stops when PC reaches this)

cycles.description: Max cycles to run (timeout, not yet implemented)

tools.name: vice_keyboard_matrix
tools.description: Direct keyboard matrix control (for games that scan keyboard directly)

key.description: Key name: A-Z, 0-9, SPACE, RETURN, F1, F3, F5, F7, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, STOP

row.description: Keyboard matrix row (0-7, alternative to key name)

col.description: Keyboard matrix column (0-7, alternative to key name)

hold_frames.description: Hold duration in frames (1-300). Key auto-releases after this many frames (~16.7ms each at 60Hz)

hold_ms.description: Hold duration in milliseconds (1-5000). Key auto-releases after this time. Overrides hold_frames if both specified

tools.name: vice_keyboard_chord
tools.description: Press multiple C64 keyboard matrix keys together for a fixed number of frames

keys.description: Keys to press simultaneously. Entries may be key names or {row,col} objects.

hold_ms.description: Hold duration in milliseconds (1-5000). Overrides hold_frames if both specified

tools.name: vice_snapshot_save
tools.description: Save complete emulator state to a named snapshot. Use this to capture a debugging checkpoint that can be restored later with snapshot.load. Snapshots are stored in ~/.config/vice/mcp_snapshots/ with JSON metadata.

name.description: Unique name for this snapshot (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen only). Choose descriptive names like 'before_crash' or 'level3_boss_fight'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what state this snapshot captures. Be specific: 'Player at level 3, about to trigger sprite collision bug'.

include_roms.description: Include ROM images in snapshot (default: false). Enable for full reproducibility, disable for smaller files.

include_disks.description: Include disk drive state in snapshot (default: false). Enable if disk contents are relevant to the bug being debugged.

tools.name: vice_snapshot_load
tools.description: Restore emulator state from a previously saved snapshot. Use this to return to a known debugging checkpoint without re-running setup steps. The emulator will be in the exact state it was when the snapshot was saved.

name.description: Name of the snapshot to load (as provided to snapshot.save). Use snapshot.list to see available snapshots.

tools.name: vice_snapshot_list
tools.description: List all available snapshots with their metadata. Returns snapshot names, descriptions, creation times, and machine types. Use this to find the right snapshot to load for debugging.

tools.name: vice_cycles_stopwatch
tools.description: Measure elapsed CPU cycles for timing-critical code analysis. Use 'reset' to start timing, 'read' to get elapsed cycles, or 'reset_and_read' for atomic read-and-reset. Ideal for measuring raster routine timing.

action.description: Action to perform: 'reset' (start timing), 'read' (get elapsed cycles), or 'reset_and_read' (atomic read and reset)

tools.name: vice_memory_fill
tools.description: Fill memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Useful for clearing memory, creating NOP sleds, or setting up test conditions. The pattern repeats to fill the entire range from start to end (inclusive).

start.description: Start address: number, hex string ($A000), or symbol name

end.description: End address (inclusive): number, hex string ($DFFF), or symbol name

pattern.description: Byte pattern to repeat, e.g., [0] for zero-fill, [0xAA, 0x55] for alternating

tools.name: vice_memory_compare
tools.description: Compare two memory ranges or compare current memory against a snapshot. Use mode='ranges' to compare two live memory ranges, or mode='snapshot' to compare against a previously saved state. Returns list of differences with addresses and values.

mode.description: Comparison mode: 'ranges' to compare two memory ranges, 'snapshot' to compare against saved state

range1_start.description: Start address of first range (for mode='ranges'): number, hex string ($1000), or symbol

range1_end.description: End address of first range (for mode='ranges'): number, hex string ($1FFF), or symbol

range2_start.description: Start address of second range (for mode='ranges'): number, hex string ($2000), or symbol

snapshot_name.description: Name of snapshot to compare against (for mode='snapshot')

start.description: Start address to compare (for mode='snapshot'): number, hex string ($A000), or symbol

end.description: End address to compare (for mode='snapshot'): number, hex string ($BFFF), or symbol

tools.name: vice_checkpoint_group_create
tools.description: Create a named checkpoint group for batch operations. Groups allow you to enable/disable multiple breakpoints at once. Optionally include initial checkpoint_ids array.

checkpoint_ids.description: Optional array of checkpoint IDs to include in the group

tools.name: vice_checkpoint_group_add
tools.description: Add checkpoints to an existing group. Use this to grow a group after creation.

group.description: Group name to add checkpoints to

checkpoint_ids.description: Array of checkpoint IDs to add to the group

tools.name: vice_checkpoint_group_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable all checkpoints in a group. Use enabled=true to enable, enabled=false to disable.

enabled.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) all checkpoints in the group

tools.name: vice_checkpoint_group_list
tools.description: List all checkpoint groups with their member counts. Returns group names, checkpoint IDs, and enabled/disabled counts.

tools.name: vice_machine_config_get
tools.description: Get current machine configuration including chips, memory map, and resources. Returns machine type, available chips, memory layout, and configurable resources.

tools.name: vice_machine_config_set
tools.description: Set machine configuration resources (WarpMode, Speed, video standard, SID model, CIA model, etc). WarpMode (0/1) disables speed limiting for fast execution. Speed (1-10000, 0=unlimited) sets CPU speed percentage. Only whitelisted resources can be changed. Returns the new configuration.

tools.name: vice_sprite_inspect
tools.description: Visual representation of sprite bitmap data. Reads sprite pointer, data, and multicolor settings to render ASCII art. ASCII Legend: '.'=transparent(00), '#'=sprite color(10), '@'=multi1(01), '%'=multi2(11).
